name: Team Charmander: Sevii Pyre Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago & Jasmine duel core — Fire incineration, Electric speed sweeping, 4x Ice execution, Intimidate Attack reduction, and 4x Fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: For Jasmine's 5 vs 5 duel on Bond Bridge, Slots 1 through 5 enter the battle: Charizard/Venusaur (Slot 1) leads with STAB Flamethrower to vaporize Skarmory/Dodrio and Scizor/Cacturne while deploying Sleep Powder; Alakazam/Raichu (Slot 2) electrocutes Skarmory/Dodrio and Magnezone/Blastoise with 120 SpA STAB Thunderbolt; Lapras (Slot 3) survives Altaria/Steelix's physical blows and retaliates with a lethal 4x STAB Ice Beam; Primeape/Sandslash (Slot 4) punches through Mawile/Rhydon with 4x super-effective Close Combat and shatters Magnezone/Blastoise with Earthquake; and Gyarados/Nidoking (Slot 5) enters with Intimidate to blunt Jasmine's physical attacks. Snorlax rests in reserve as the route endurance tank.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor elevated to Cap 76. Charcoal-boosted STAB Flamethrower burns through Skarmory/Dodrio and Scizor/Cacturne. Sleep Powder disables setup sweepers immediately.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. STAB Thunderbolt electrocutes Skarmory/Dodrio and Magnezone/Blastoise for massive super-effective damage. Recover provides instant longevity.

535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 75. Sponges Altaria/Steelix's ground and dragon moves, then retaliates with a lethal 4x STAB Ice Beam. Water Absorb completely counters Magnezone/Blastoise's water moves.
477 BST physical wallbreaker. STAB Close Combat delivers 4x super-effective devastation against Mawile/Rhydon. STAB Earthquake crushes Magnezone/Blastoise.
522 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts Jasmine's physical Attack on entry to blunt incoming Heavy Slams and Stone Edges. STAB Aqua Tail washes away ground and rock foes.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. RestTalk loop absorbs wild status and damage across Kin Island and Berry Forest while resting in reserve during the 5v5 Gym duel.

flex_bench.rationale: High-speed Flying pivot providing team speed acceleration and super-effective Flying STAB.
Ground-immune physical wall packing Sludge Bomb and Will-O-Wisp for burn suppression.
Iron Fist-boosted Fire Punch provides custom super-effective physical coverage against Steel types.
